BUSI 100.course_name: Micro Foundations of Real Estate Economics
BUSI 100.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 100.description: Basic principles of microeconomics and application to current economic problems.

BUSI 101.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 101.description: Basic principles of macroeconomics and application to current economic problems. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 100.

BUSI 111.course_name: British Columbia Real Estate Law and Real Estate Ethics
BUSI 111.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 111.description: Canadian legal system and contract law and detailed aspects of real estate law as it applies in British Columbia.

BUSI 112.course_name: Canadian Real Property Law and Real Estate Ethics
BUSI 112.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 112.description: Canadian legal system and contract law and detailed aspects of real estate law as it applies across Canada.

BUSI 121.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 121.description: Introduction to mathematics of real estate finance and statistical measures and methods and their application to practical real estate concepts.

BUSI 221.course_name: Real Estate Finance in a Canadian Context
BUSI 221.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 221.description: History, function and mechanics of Canadian mortgage markets. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 121.

BUSI 290.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 290.description: Introduction to decision models in business, including basic optimization, linear programming, probability, decision analysis, random variables, simulation, and solving decision problems using spreadsheet tools.

BUSI 291.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 291.description: Methods and applications of statistics in business; data analysis, descriptive regression; data generation; sampling distributions; hypothesis testing; confidence intervals; two sample problems; inference in regression. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 293.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 293.description: Introduction to the construction and interpretation of financial reports prepared primarily for external use. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 294.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 294.description: Introduction to the development and use of accounting information for management planning and control, and the development of cost information for financial reports. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 293. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 295.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 295.description: Introduction to microeconomics and macroeconomics principles with applications to accounting and business decision making. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 299.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 299.description: Basic communication theory, communications in organizations. Includes written and oral practice in lab sessions.

BUSI 300.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 300.description: Comprehensive treatment of urban and real estate economics; introduction to study of cities and real estate market; analytical microeconomic principles. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 100, BUSI_V 101.

BUSI 329.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 329.description: An introductory examination of work organizations and the behaviour of individuals within them. Phenomena to be studied include organizational structure, environments, group processes, motivation and leadership. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 330.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 330.description: Introduction to concepts and techniques for appraising the value of real estate. Recommended prerequisite: BUSI_V 121.

BUSI 331.course_name: Real Estate Investment Analysis and Advanced Income Appraisal
BUSI 331.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 331.description: Valuation techniques for income real estate, including income method of appraisal, tax consequences of real property ownership, and portfolio analysis methodology. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 121, BUSI_V 330.

BUSI 335.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 335.description: Introduction to information technology related to business use: design, implementation, and application of information systems. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 344.course_name: Statistical and Computer Applications in Valuation
BUSI 344.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 344.description: Explores creative, practical uses of statistical and computer applications in determining and analyzing real estate value. Through case studies and hands-on computer work, students will learn the fundamentals of exploratory data analysis and appraisal valuation modelling.

BUSI 352.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 352.description: Examines common issues that affect the practice of residential real estate valuation. Credit will be granted for only one of BUSI_V 352 or both BUSI_V 442 and BUSI_V 452. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 330. BUSI_V 121, BUSI_V 344 are recommended.

BUSI 353.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 353.description: An examination of accounting as a means of measurement and as an information system for external reporting purposes. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 293 or equivalent. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 354.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 354.description: The provision and analysis of cost accounting information that will assist management in making operating decisions and in evaluating operational performance. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 294. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 355.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 355.description: A study of income tax from the standpoint of the individual and business enterprise. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 293 or equivalent. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 370.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 370.description: An introduction to the basic principles of financial valuation and an examination of corporate enterprise decisions including working capital management; capital budgeting; capital structures and dividend policy. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 293 or equivalent. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 391.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 391.description: Overview of computer technology and terminology; use of computers as managerial and administrative tools; the management of computer resources and the influence of information technology within the organization. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 393.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 393.description: Introduction to the law of contracts, with particular reference to contracts for sale of goods and related law of personal property, principles of agency, partnership, and company law. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 398.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 398.description: The residential property appraisal process, focusing both on valuation techniques as well as general research and report writing skills.

BUSI 399.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 399.description: The design and management of systems to make products, provide services and deliver them to the end user. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 290, BUSI_V 291 or equivalents. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 400.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 400.description: Underlying theory and techniques used in design, construction, and inspection of residential properties.

BUSI 401.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 401.description: Underlying theory and techniques used in the design and construction of commercial properties.

BUSI 414.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 414.description: Builds critical thinking and data skills by identifying statistical pitfalls, cleaning data with Power Query, creating financial models, and crafting impactful visualizations using Power BI and Excel to support decision-making through practical applications. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 291, BUSI_V 335. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 433.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 433.description: General business skills for real estate practitioners.

BUSI 441.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 441.description: Examines the day-to-day issues which affect the practice of property management. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 330. BUSI_V 331 is recommended.

BUSI 442.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 442.description: Examines the day-to-day issues that affect the practice of real estate appraisal. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 121, BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331.

BUSI 443.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 443.description: Introduces the practice of real property assessment, including the nature of the techniques used, the required duties of assessors, and how an assessment office is administrated. Recommended prerequisite: BUSI_V 330.

BUSI 444.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 444.description: This course develops and applies the major techniques for valuing real property. Recommended prerequisites: All of BUSI_V 121, BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 443.

BUSI 445.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 445.description: Real estate development process from the project idea to the cursory feasibility stage. Steps in development planning, including analysis, design and evaluation. Evaluating development potential, land acquisition, and site planning. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331.

BUSI 446.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 446.description: Analysis of real estate development process with an examination of economic feasibility studies, approval processes, project financing, construction, project management, and marketing phases. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 445.

BUSI 447.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 447.description: Project management methodology based on the practices defined by the Project Management Institute, including planning, execution, monitoring, control, and completion. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 450.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 450.description: A continuation of the examination of accounting as a means of measurement and as an information system for external reporting purposes. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 293, BUSI_V 370. Corequisite: BUSI_V 353. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 451.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration

BUSI 452.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 452.description: Continuation of BUSI_V 442. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 453.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 453.description: An examination of advanced financial accounting topics. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 353, BUSI_V 450. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 454.course_name: Accounting for Management Control and Incentives
BUSI 454.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 454.description: Design of accounting systems for facilitating and influencing management decisions, with emphasis on performance evaluation in organizations. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 294.

BUSI 455.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 455.description: Principles of internal control; audit evidence; sampling and testing; audit reports; standards and responsibilities of the external audit. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 353. Corequisite: BUSI_V 450. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 460.course_name: Critical Analysis and Forecasting in Real Estate
BUSI 460.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 460.description: Delves into two quantitative decision-making methodologies--decision analysis and forecasting--and explores them using a problem-solving framework. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 121. BUSI_V 331 and BUSI_V 444 are also recommended.

BUSI 465.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 465.description: Basic considerations affecting the domestic and international marketing of goods and services. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 293, BUSI_V 295. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 470.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 470.description: Prerequisite: One of BUSI_V 370, COMM_V 473. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 485.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 485.description: Analysis of business and financial decisions in the presence of taxes. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 486.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration

BUSI 493.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 493.description: A conceptual and practical introduction to the major areas of business strategy with an integrative perspective on managing a business. Includes the analysis of a business and its environment, the development and evaluation of strategic alternatives, and implementation of change. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 291, BUSI_V 293, BUSI_V 294, BUSI_V 295, BUSI_V 335, BUSI_V 353, BUSI_V 370, BUSI_V 393, BUSI_V 450. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

BUSI 497.course_name: Guided Case Study in Agricultural Real Estate
BUSI 497.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 497.description: An agriculturally-focused version of BUSI_V 499. Prerequisite: All of BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331, BUSI_V 442, BUSI_V 452.

BUSI 498.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 498.description: Development of general environmental framework for international business studies by drawing on international and development economics, research into government-business relations and studies in comparative socio-cultural systems and political systems. Prerequisite: BUSI_V 293 and either (a) all of ECON_V 101, ECON_V 102 or (b) ECON_V 309. Corequisite: Two of BUSI_V 294, BUSI_V 329, BUSI_V 370, BUSI_V 465.

BUSI 499.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
BUSI 499.description: The income property appraisal process, focusing both on valuation techniques as well as general research and report writing skills. All of BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331, BUSI_V 442, BUSI_V 452.
